assets.label: hydrocarbon transfer pumps
assets.service: hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast
receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: lock out tag out failure on P-4102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BLAST_GUARDING_AND_CLEARANCE: the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control EXPLOSIVES_RECONCILIATION: the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives on P-4102, M-4102 and PT-4102 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in storing and transporting explosives, specifically receiving, magazining and reconciling explosives. P-4102 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the guarding, clearance and misfire handling for a blast had been bypassed. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 7 May 2013 an incident occurred on P-4102, M-4102 and PT-4102 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a breakdown response, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
